info.about: Tech Romancer is a 1998 3D fighting arcade game by Capcom that draws heavily from the various subgenres of mecha anime. It was later ported to the Dreamcast console.
info.trivia: Studio Nue designed the robots, and each robot's story mode plays out like an anime series, with episode titles and eyecatches between fights.
info.why: Capcom never ported it beyond the Dreamcast, so the Dreamcast disc is the only home version of the arcade game.
